templates.why_chosen: Star-rated: a coarse lifecycle timeline (Factory to Data Center Operation) highlights one stage, Online SDC Detection, in red and drops a shaded wedge into AEGIS's per-GPU timeline, where circled steps 1-5 flag one suspicious op.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw a coarse lifecycle timeline across the top, pick out the one stage your system owns in a distinct color, and drop a shaded wedge straight down from it into the detailed mechanism diagram, reusing numbered steps to walk sense-then-verify across a per-unit execution timeline inside that mechanism.
